description:
A sociological study on community cohesion is being launched, but the survey settings need adjustment before publication. The Institutional Review Board (IRB) requires that all rating scale questions (Q1 through Q9) must be mandatory to ensure statistical validity, while the open-ended feedback question (Q10) must remain optional.

Log in to LimeSurvey (admin / Admin123!), navigate to the inactive survey 'Community Cohesion Index 2025', and perform the following:
1. Update questions Q1 through Q9 to be 'Mandatory'.
2. Ensure Q10 remains 'Optional'.
3. Activate the survey (Open-access mode).

You can update questions individually or use the 'Selected questions...' mass action feature in the question list for efficiency.
